# PingOne Platform APIs - Early Access

> AI agents should consult [Docs for Agents](https://developer.pingidentity.com/build-with-ai/docs-for-agents.md)
> for guidance on navigating Ping Identity documentation.

## Pingone Api Ea

- [Authorization Attributes](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-trust-framework/authorization-attributes/index.md): Early access endpoints to create, read, update, test, and delete PingOne Authorize trust framework attributes, plus their data model and event types
- [Authorization Conditions](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-trust-framework/authorization-conditions/index.md): Early access endpoints to create, read, update, test, and delete PingOne Authorize trust framework conditions, plus their data model and event types
- [Authorization Connector Templates](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-trust-framework/authorization-connector-templates/index.md): Early access endpoint to read PingOne Authorize trust framework connector templates associated with your environment, plus their data model
- [Authorization Policies](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-editor-policy-management/authorization-policies/index.md): Early access endpoints to create, read, update, test, and delete PingOne Authorize authorization policies, plus their data model and event types
- [Authorization Processors](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-trust-framework/authorization-processors/index.md): Early access endpoints to create, read, update, and delete PingOne Authorize trust framework processors, plus their data model and event types
- [Authorization Rules](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-editor-policy-management/authorization-rules/index.md): Early access endpoints to create, read, update, test, and delete PingOne Authorize authorization rules, plus their data model and event types
- [Authorization Services](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-trust-framework/authorization-services/index.md): Early access endpoints to create, read, update, test, and delete PingOne Authorize trust framework services, plus their data model and event types
- [Authorization Statements](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-editor-policy-management/authorization-statements/index.md): Early access endpoints to create, read, update, and delete PingOne Authorize authorization statements, plus their data model and event types
- [Configuration Management](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/index.md): Describes the early access PingOne Configuration Management service for promoting configurations across environments, including snapshots, promotions, and variables
- [Create Authorization Attribute](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-trust-framework/authorization-attributes/create-authorization-attribute.md): Early access operation to create a PingOne Authorize trust framework attribute in an environment
- [Create Authorization Condition](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-trust-framework/authorization-conditions/create-authorization-condition.md): Early access operation to create a PingOne Authorize trust framework condition in an environment
- [Create Authorization Policy](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-editor-policy-management/authorization-policies/create-authorization-policy.md): Early access operation to create a PingOne Authorize authorization policy in an environment
- [Create Authorization Processor](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-trust-framework/authorization-processors/create-authorization-processor.md): Early access operation to create a PingOne Authorize trust framework processor in an environment
- [Create Authorization Rule](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-editor-policy-management/authorization-rules/create-authorization-rule.md): Early access operation to create a PingOne Authorize authorization rule in an environment
- [Create Authorization Service](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-trust-framework/authorization-services/create-authorization-service.md): Early access operation to create a PingOne Authorize trust framework service in an environment
- [Create Authorization Statement](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-editor-policy-management/authorization-statements/create-authorization-statement.md): Early access operation to create a PingOne Authorize authorization statement in an environment
- [Create Custom Push Provider](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/push-delivery-settings/create_custom_push_provider.md): Create a custom push notification provider using the early access pushDeliverySettings endpoint in PingOne
- [Create Promotion](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/promotions/create-promotion.md): Create a PingOne promotion to move configuration resources from a source environment to a target environment
- [Create Snapshot](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/snapshots/create-snapshot.md): Generate a snapshot of a PingOne configuration resource for use in a promotion
- [Create Variable Declaration](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/promotion-variables/variable-declarations/create-variable-declaration.md): Declare a promotion variable, binding a variable definition to a configuration resource attribute for a PingOne promotion
- [Create Variable Definition](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/promotion-variables/variable-definitions/create-variable-definition.md): Define a promotion variable value to substitute for a configuration resource property in a PingOne promotion
- [Delete Authorization Attribute](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-trust-framework/authorization-attributes/delete-authorization-attribute.md): Early access operation to delete a PingOne Authorize trust framework attribute from an environment
- [Delete Authorization Condition](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-trust-framework/authorization-conditions/delete-authorization-condition.md): Early access operation to delete a PingOne Authorize trust framework condition from an environment
- [Delete Authorization Policy](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-editor-policy-management/authorization-policies/delete-authorization-policy.md): Early access operation to delete a PingOne Authorize authorization policy from an environment
- [Delete Authorization Processor](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-trust-framework/authorization-processors/delete-authorization-processor.md): Early access operation to delete a PingOne Authorize trust framework processor from an environment
- [Delete Authorization Rule](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-editor-policy-management/authorization-rules/delete-authorization-rule.md): Early access operation to delete a PingOne Authorize authorization rule from an environment
- [Delete Authorization Service](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-trust-framework/authorization-services/delete-authorization-service.md): Early access operation to delete a PingOne Authorize trust framework service from an environment
- [Delete Authorization Statement](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-editor-policy-management/authorization-statements/delete-authorization-statement.md): Early access operation to delete a PingOne Authorize authorization statement from an environment
- [Delete Promotion](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/promotions/delete-promotion.md): Delete the specified PingOne promotion
- [Delete Variable Declaration](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/promotion-variables/variable-declarations/delete-variable-declaration.md): Delete a promotion variable declaration in a PingOne environment
- [Delete Variable Definition](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/promotion-variables/variable-definitions/delete-variable-definition.md): Delete a promotion variable definition in a PingOne environment
- [Document Authentication Using NFC Chip Verification](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/verify/early-access/document-authentication-using-nfc-chip-verification/index.md): Describes the early access NFC-based document authentication for mobile PingOne Verify and how to enable it for preview in an environment
- [Early Access](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/auth/early-access.md): Explains support terms for PingOne early access features and how to enable them for preview in a specified environment
- [Early Access](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/index.md): Describes PingOne Authorize early access features, their preview support terms, and how to enable them for your environment
- [Early Access](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/index.md): Describes support expectations for PingOne early access features, which are preview-only and not covered under standard Support SLAs
- [Early Access](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/verify/early-access/index.md): Explains support terms for PingOne early access features and how to enable them for preview in a specified environment
- [Excluded Resources](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/promotions/excluded-resources.md): Lists the PingOne products, services, and resources that are excluded or currently unsupported for promotion operations
- [MCP Server](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/mcp-server/index.md): Describes the early access PingOne MCP Settings API for managing Model Context Protocol access in an environment
- [PingOne Authorize - Early Access](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/index.md): Explains how to enable and use PingOne Authorize early access APIs, which apply only to environments where you turn on the feature
- [PingOne Authorize Admin APIs](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/index.md): Early access PingOne Authorize Admin API endpoints for the trust framework and policy management, requiring PING_ONE_AUTHORIZE in your environment's Bill of Materials
- [PingOne Authorize Editor Policy Management](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-editor-policy-management/index.md): Early access endpoints for managing PingOne Authorize policies, statements, and rules that model business requirements into authorization logic
- [PingOne Authorize Trust Framework](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-trust-framework/index.md): Early access endpoints for managing PingOne Authorize trust framework attributes, services, conditions, processors, and connector templates
- [PingOne Platform APIs - Early Access](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/index.md): Overview of the PingOne Platform APIs for early access to new features, covering SSO, Auth, MFA, Authorize, DaVinci, Credentials, Verify, and Protect services
- [PingOne Verify - Early Access](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/verify/index.md): Introduces the PingOne Verify early access APIs, which you enable per environment to preview upcoming authentication features before general availability
- [Platform Auth APIs - Early Access](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/auth/index.md): Introduces the PingOne Platform Auth early access APIs, which you enable per environment to preview upcoming authentication features before general availability
- [Platform SSO APIs - Early Access](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/index.md): Explains how to enable PingOne early access APIs for a specific environment and remove them at any time during the early access period
- [Promotion Configuration](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/promotion-configuration/index.md): Describes the PingOne promotionConfiguration endpoint for setting and reading the default target environment used for promotions
- [Promotion Mappings](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/promotion-mappings/index.md): Explains how PingOne Promotion Mappings operations track the mapping of source environment resources to target environment resources
- [Promotion Variables](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/promotion-variables/index.md): Explains how to use promotion variables to substitute environment-specific property values, such as URLs, during a PingOne configuration promotion
- [Promotions](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/promotions/index.md): Describes PingOne promotions, which move configuration resources from a source environment to a target environment, and how to roll one back
- [Push Delivery Settings](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/push-delivery-settings/index.md): Describes the early access pushDeliverySettings endpoint for defining a custom gateway to send PingOne push notifications through your own provider
- [Read All Custom Push Providers](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/push-delivery-settings/get_custom_push_providers.md): Return the custom push notification providers defined for a PingOne environment using the early access pushDeliverySettings endpoint
- [Read All Promotions](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/promotions/get-all-promotions.md): Return the details for all PingOne promotions, with optional filtering by status
- [Read All Snapshot Versions](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/snapshots/get-all-snapshot-versions.md): Return the version information for all versions of a PingOne configuration resource snapshot
- [Read All Variable Definitions](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/promotion-variables/variable-definitions/get-all-variable-definitions.md): Return all promotion variable definitions defined in a PingOne environment
- [Read Authorization Attributes](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-trust-framework/authorization-attributes/read-authorization-attributes.md): Early access operation to read all PingOne Authorize trust framework attributes in an environment
- [Read Authorization Conditions](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-trust-framework/authorization-conditions/read-authorization-conditions.md): Early access operation to read all PingOne Authorize trust framework conditions in an environment
- [Read Authorization Connector Templates](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-trust-framework/authorization-connector-templates/read-authorization-connector-templates.md): Early access operation to read the PingOne Authorize trust framework connector templates available in an environment
- [Read Authorization Policies](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-editor-policy-management/authorization-policies/read-authorization-policies.md): Early access operation to read all PingOne Authorize authorization policies in an environment
- [Read Authorization Processors](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-trust-framework/authorization-processors/read-authorization-processors.md): Early access operation to read all PingOne Authorize trust framework processors in an environment
- [Read Authorization Rules](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-editor-policy-management/authorization-rules/read-authorization-rules.md): Early access operation to read all PingOne Authorize authorization rules in an environment
- [Read Authorization Services](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-trust-framework/authorization-services/read-authorization-services.md): Early access operation to read all PingOne Authorize trust framework services in an environment
- [Read Authorization Statements](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-editor-policy-management/authorization-statements/read-authorization-statements.md): Early access operation to read all PingOne Authorize authorization statements in an environment
- [Read Embedded Snapshot Versions](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/snapshots/get-embedded-snapshot-versions.md): Return the list of embedded snapshots for a specific version of a PingOne configuration resource
- [Read Embedded Snapshots](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/snapshots/get-embedded-snapshots.md): Return the list of embedded snapshots created during a PingOne promotion for a configuration resource
- [Read Latest Snapshot](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/snapshots/get-latest-snapshot.md): Return the latest snapshot information for a specified PingOne configuration resource
- [Read MCP Settings](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/mcp-server/read-mcp-settings.md): Retrieve the MCP settings for a specified PingOne environment
- [Read One Authorization Attribute](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-trust-framework/authorization-attributes/read-one-authorization-attribute.md): Early access operation to read a single PingOne Authorize trust framework attribute by ID

- [Read One Promotion](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/promotions/get-one-promotion.md): Return the details and generated promotion plan for the specified PingOne promotion
- [Read One Snapshot Version](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/snapshots/get-one-snapshot-version.md): Return the version information for a specific snapshot of a PingOne configuration resource
- [Read One Variable Definition](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/promotion-variables/variable-definitions/get-one-variable-definition.md): Return a specific promotion variable definition defined in a PingOne environment
- [Read One Verification MetaData](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/verify/early-access/document-authentication-using-nfc-chip-verification/verification-metadata/read-one-verification-metadata.md): Retrieve one identity verification metadata result for a specified user's verification transaction in PingOne Verify
- [Read Promotion Configuration](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/promotion-configuration/get-promotion-configuration.md): Return the default target environment configured for PingOne promotions
- [Read Promotion Mappings](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/promotion-mappings/get-promotion-mappings.md): Return the resource mappings between the source and target environments used by a PingOne promotion
- [Read Promotion Status](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/promotions/get-promotion-status.md): Return the status information for the specified PingOne promotion
- [Read Promotion Steps](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/promotions/get-promotion-steps.md): Return the promotion plan operations, including the payload for each step, for the specified PingOne promotion
- [Read Variable Declarations](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/promotion-variables/variable-declarations/get-variable-declarations.md): Return the promotion variable declarations defined in a PingOne environment
- [Roll Back a Promotion](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/promotions/rollback-promotion.md): Roll back the most recently executed PingOne promotion, restoring the target environment to its prior state
- [Snapshots](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/snapshots/index.md): Describes PingOne configuration snapshots, point-in-time representations of a configuration resource and its dependencies used for promotion

- [Update Authorization Condition](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/authorize/early-access/pingone-authorize-admin-apis/pingauthorize-trust-framework/authorization-conditions/update-authorization-condition.md): Early access operation to update an existing PingOne Authorize trust framework condition

- [Update Variable Declaration](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/promotion-variables/variable-declarations/patch-update-variable-declaration.md): Partially update a promotion variable declaration in a PingOne environment
- [Update Variable Declaration](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/promotion-variables/variable-declarations/update-variable-declaration.md): Update a promotion variable declaration in a PingOne environment
- [Update Variable Definition](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/promotion-variables/variable-definitions/update-variable-definition.md): Update a promotion variable definition in a PingOne environment
- [Variable Declarations](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/promotion-variables/variable-declarations/index.md): Explains how to declare a promotion variable, associating a defined variable with the resource attributes used during a PingOne promotion
- [Variable Definitions](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/promotion-variables/variable-definitions/index.md): Explains how to define promotion variables that hold the values substituted for configuration resource properties during a PingOne promotion
- [Variable Resources](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/promotion-variables/variable-resources/get-variable-resources.md): Return the resources in a PingOne environment that support promotion variables
- [Variable Resources](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/platform/early-access/configuration-management/promotion-variables/variable-resources/index.md): Lists the PingOne configuration resources and properties that are supported for use as promotion variables
- [Verification MetaData](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/verify/early-access/document-authentication-using-nfc-chip-verification/verification-metadata/index.md): Explains the PingOne Verify verification metaData data model and endpoint for retrieving scores from a verification transaction
- [Verify Policies](https://developer.pingidentity.com/pingone-api-ea/verify/early-access/document-authentication-using-nfc-chip-verification/verify-policy.md): Explains PingOne Verify policies for configuring identity verification requirements, parameters, and checks in an environment
